title: fix: update build-golang CI job to pull golang:1.26-alpine matching go.mod
body:
The `build-golang` job in `test-integration.yaml` was pulling `golang:1.25-alpine`, mismatched against `go.mod` (requires Go 1.26), `Dockerfile.tailscale-HEAD` (`FROM golang:1.26-alpine`), and `cmd/hi` (auto-detects Go version from `go.mod` → looks for `golang:1.26` image). This caused Docker Hub pulls at test runtime and potential version mismatches.

- **`.github/workflows/test-integration.yaml`**: Update `build-golang` job to pull and save `golang:1.26-alpine` instead of `golang:1.25-alpine`
